_note: Hand-edited, keyed by radioId (uppercase). `verified: true` promotes a model to the Verified tier in docs/models.md; `notes` is shown in that table's Notes column. `defaults` (optional) sets this model's out-of-the-box readback/polling settings from verified findings -- `readback` (poll the light for live state) and `poll_cct` (trust its reported colour temperature); they pre-fill the checkboxes when a light of this model is configured, and a global fallback (readback off, poll_cct on) applies to models without an entry. Entries with `verified: false` are allowed too -- use them to record a quirk on a model no one has fully confirmed yet. Regenerate docs/models.md with `uv run python scripts/generate_model_support.py` and capabilities_data.json with `uv run python scripts/generate_capabilities.py`. Community reports come in via https://github.com/binary-person/ha-godox-mesh/issues/1; curate the useful ones into this file.
